question: Which of the following multinational air combat exercises did the Indian Air Force (IAF) participate in at Al Dhafra Air Base in the UAE from 21 April to 8 May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Desert Flag-10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Air Force (IAF)** participated in the multinational air combat exercise **Desert Flag-10** at the **Al Dhafra Air Base** in the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**.
 
• This exercise was held between **21 April and 8 May 2025**.
 
• **Desert Flag** is an annual multinational exercise hosted by the **UAE Air Force**, which focuses on enhancing **interoperability and cooperation** among participating nations.
 
• The exercise provides an opportunity for the IAF to **train with air forces from various countries** and improve its operational capabilities.
 
• Participation in such exercises allows the IAF to test its **state-of-the-art aircraft, technology, and operational strategies** in a multinational environment.
 
• The event also helps foster **diplomatic relations** and strengthen **military partnerships** between India and other participant nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Red Flag**__

 __
 
• The **Red Flag** exercise is a premier air combat training exercise hosted by the **United States Air Force (USAF)**.
 
• It is conducted at the **Nellis Air Force Base** in Nevada, USA.
 
• The exercise is designed to provide realistic combat training in a simulated war environment and involves advanced **air combat tactics and operations.**
 
 
 
• **Iron Fist**__
 __
 
• **Iron Fist** is a biennial military exercise conducted by the **Indian Air Force**.
 
• The exercise demonstrates the **firepower capabilities** of the IAF, including fighter jets, transport aircraft, and helicopters.
 
• It is aimed at showcasing the operational readiness of the IAF to defend the country.
 
 
 
• **Blue Flag-5**__
 
 
• **Blue Flag** is a multinational air exercise hosted by the **Israeli Air Force (IAF)**.
 
• It focuses on enhancing **strategic cooperation, interoperability, and learning from other air forces**.
 
• The fifth edition of the exercise, **Blue Flag-5**, involved participants from several countries.
